lines.text: It starts to rain on a grey street. @maya_front opens a bright yellow @umbrella_open and grins up at the sky.
Slow push in; the yellow is the only colour.

new_beats.text: Rain drums on the yellow canopy as passers-by hurry past in grey.

writes.note: I added a beat at 3 s where the rain drums on the canopy and the grey crowd hurries past.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a reaction from the world around Maya; a late beat of rain on the canopy and grey passers-by strengthens the yellow-only-colour contrast without changing the existing words.
